summary: Pembina Pipeline Corporation filed a Form 6-K with voting results from its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders held May 8, 2026. The filing reports that 10 director nominees were elected and KPMG was appointed as auditor, along with an advisory vote on executive compensation. All votes were overwhelmingly in favor. This is a routine annual meeting report without any special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or management change.
